name: ASM-016 cordless drill chuck-front assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a cordless drill front module with gearbox nose, torque clutch ring, chuck sleeve, jaws, bit, LEDs, sockets, and screws.

tasks.prompt: Create a cordless drill chuck/front module assembly with gearbox nose housing, torque clutch ring, keyless chuck sleeve, three jaws, driver bit, front LED, auxiliary handle sockets, clutch windows, and repeated case screws. Use simple robust primitives.
assumptions: Intermediate appliance/tooling benchmark focuses on recognizable drill-front modules without fragile tiny serrations.
Repeated screws, jaws, windows, and sockets are meaningful assembly occurrences.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD benchmark pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
